title: Research 2026-10-26
body: Studied: 2,340 settled engine and phone bets and bids (auto-bets and bids only, your hand bets excluded) plus 1,523 engine orders. Result: about break-even overall (ROI -0.4%) but beating the close by +1.5%, so the edge is real and results are noise. Team totals are the proven winner (+16.0%, z +2.9). Moneylines are the leak (-47.7%, z -2.45) but only 117 settled, under the 200-bet gate, so nothing changed yet; I will tighten them when the next digest passes 200. NBA CLV is negative (-5.0%) on only 59 closes: watching. Settings changed: none. Engine: healthy, auto-bets rising 3 to 69 a day, bids 105-189 fills a day; top blocker is the over-48-hour trap guard, kept. 4 engine orders are unconfirmed and need reconciling.
